mechanism_narrative: A lower level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) directly reduces the discount rate applied to equity cash flows, increasing the present value of future earnings and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without regime dependence.
failure_condition: Rank IC for FEDFUNDS against 20-day SPX returns falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window or correlation is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment exceeding 10.0% (UNRATE >= 10.0) signals severe labor market distress that increases equity risk premiums and depresses S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in >60% of UNRATE >= 10.0 instances or average return not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in unemployment (UNRATE) and declines in employment (PAYEMS) indicate deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Interaction term (PAYEMS * UNRATE) not significant (p > 0.05) or Rank IC for interaction below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Ultra-low interest rate environments (FEDFUNDS <= 0.5%) trigger yield-seeking behavior in equity markets, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as investors rotate from fixed income to equities.
failure_condition: Average 60-day return not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC below 0.03 in FEDFUNDS <= 0.5 regime.

mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts (HOUST) indicate improving consumer confidence and economic activity, directly boosting corporate earnings and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without threshold conditions.
failure_condition: Rank IC for HOUST against 20-day SPX returns below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window or correlation not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production falling below 95.0 (INDPRO < 95.0) signals manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate profitability and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in >60% of INDPRO < 95.0 instances or average return not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between ultra-low rates (FEDFUNDS <= 0.5%) and elevated inflation expectations (CPIAUCSL > 215) creates a 'growth-at-all-costs' environment that drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Interaction term (FEDFUNDS * CPIAUCSL) not significant (p > 0.05) or Rank IC for interaction below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes (UNRATE < 5.0 AND INDPRO > 100.0), rising residential sales (RSAFS) signals sustained consumer spending that supports corporate earnings and generates positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Average 5-day return not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC for RSAFS below 0.03 in UNRATE < 5.0 AND INDPRO > 100.0 regime.
